cd_tokens: action dims 0..5, gripper dim 6 keeps clean
guided_prefix: both branches share a_{<q}^* = clean greedy tokens; negative branch teacher-forced

kmeans.selector: entity_set KMeans top-1 cos match (source/target), deduped

pairing: capture-once-reuse; hash-verified fail-closed across all 5 arms

random_recon_k8_m10.groups: q random NON-semantic groups (q = #semantic groups), size-matched within 20%
random_recon_k8_m10.repro: rng seed = SeedSequence([task_id, episode_seed, timestep, 0x5CEED]); resample <=200x

reconstruction.basis: M tokens FPS on cosine distance from C = V \ G (L2-normalized for FPS, RAW for reconstruction)
reconstruction.operator: v_i -> mu_B + B_c alpha_i; alpha=(B_c^T B_c + rho I)^{-1} B_c^T (v_i - mu_B)
reconstruction.rho: rho = 1e-3 * tr(B_c^T B_c) / M (fixed, not swept)
reconstruction.scope: source AND target groups excluded from basis; computed once per control observation

vanilla: re-run here (5-arm snapshot pairing), not reused
